covariates: same combined task/timing/strictly-causal history/drift Poisson GLM offsets in every family; validation one-SE choice among M3 combined ridge candidates; coefficients fitted training only, counted as fitted parameters
discrete: Poisson HMM; train EM exact forward-backward; state-specific unit intercepts plus common offset
continuous: Poisson linear Gaussian latent dynamics; fixed initial N(0,I), fixed process covariance I, fitted full A and observation C/intercept; exp log link
hybrid: switching linear Gaussian latent dynamics with Markov discrete states, state-specific A and intercept, shared C, fixed initial N(0,I)/process covariance I
latent_fit: Gaussian-chain/discrete-chain mean-field variational EM with analytic expected Poisson log likelihood; Laplace covariance fixed-point updates; ELBO only training objective, never predictive endpoint
initialization: training residual log(count+0.5) SVD for latent initialization only; real likelihood remains Poisson; identical seeds from M0
convergence: five consecutive finite objective changes below tolerance; required candidate/seed failure stops before final test access
numerical: transition probabilities floored1e-12 and renormalized; emission weighted M-step ridge1e-6; A M-step ridge1e-6; no validation-driven numerical repair or family removal
metric: joint population count predictive log likelihood integrated before any current-bin assimilation; normalize by identical observed unit-bins
inference: exact HMM filter; bootstrap joint state/latent particle filter for continuous/hybrid, trials reset; systematic resampling after scoring each bin
accuracy_validation: independent repeated particle estimates plus higher-budget reference; reference16384 and32768 with4 independent seeds, compare errors and repeat SE; reference uncertainty and candidate total conservative discrepancy <=0.001 nats/unit-bin required; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and scientific gate FAIL
selection: training-converged models only; whole-validation-trial one-SE selection using fitted free parameter count, then dimension/state count; final holdout requires frozen all selections and estimator accuracy PASS
free_parameters: all training-fitted common GLM coefficients plus HMM K*U+K*(K-1)+(K-1); continuous U*D+U+D*D; hybrid U*D+K*U+K*D*D+K*(K-1)+(K-1). Fixed covariances excluded; raw fitted parameter counts, rotation nonidentifiability disclosed
external_identity: no persistent neuron or learned emission transfer across sessions
